summary.content:
Today's selection covers 56 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 36 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: 'Yellow Teams' Are Defining the Future of AI Security
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Turning the Tables on Email Scammers With 'ScamBuster'
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 36 articles published in the last 24 hours
